# Offline German speech

This directory contains unmodified meSpeak 1.9.6 by Norbert Landsteiner
(2011–2014), based on speak.js and eSpeak, distributed under the GNU General
Public License. See LICENSE for the complete GPLv3 text.

Original project, documentation, and source download:
https://www.masswerk.at/mespeak/

Vendored JavaScript source and voice/configuration data:
https://github.com/foxdog-studios/meSpeak

Original Git blob SHAs:
- mespeak.js: 1eb4893139ad18f22a12dcf0d3889a5ee21809b9
- mespeak_config.json: 8e46e04c8ea9eff6bffad6907e8b92f91d8bfca8

The runtime generates German pronunciation locally on the device. It does not
send vocabulary, account information, or audio requests to a speech service.
